coverage.why: All seven accounting areas and industry_lens have a finding and a verdict, and the financial reading answers profitability, efficiency, liquidity, solvency, growth and free_cash_flow. The one gate drop removed a single sentence (the 2030 Notes conversion window) from cross_document_reconciliation, so that point is unanswered but the area is not.

calibration.why: Each area verdict matches its anomalies; for example, cross_document_reconciliation names the Koi, commitments, capped-call and two pipeline points it lists. There are slips: the fair-value-option anomaly calls the loss's location open while cost_deferral places it in other income, and the controls finding calls in-quarter 8-Ks 'other events' though input_8k.md lists '1.01, 2.03, 9.01' on 2026-04-13.

valuation_reading.why: price_position and market_implied_growth correctly report market.missing and implied_growth_beside_history.implied_ten_year_revenue_growth as missing. most_sensitive picks year-ten margin and year-one growth from the spread of assumptions.json scenarios, not from the calculator, because valuation.missing means no sensitivity grid exists.
